headline: Revenue and profit both grow from the prior quarter
summary_short: Revenue was INR 100,755M, up 3.8% q/q, and net income rose 15.1% to INR 13,229M; EPS of INR 11.01 was up 77.9% y/y.
summary_long: EBITDA grew 11.6% q/q to INR 35,481M and operating income grew 3.2% to INR 25,001M. Net income grew faster than operating income. No year-over-year revenue comparison is on the shard. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
